ops.body: 2026-07-27 field recurrence on 12.20.12 (local yBook-Pro): NOT resolved by the 12.20.12 convergence — remove it from the "possibly fixed, verify" bucket. Host 81227 + helper 81205 both healthy for 8h, yet `capt-hook helper status` → "helper not reachable: bridge failed: disconnected", concurrent with machine load 64–86 (11-lane release wave). EAGAIN-fatal fits the flap exactly: errno-35 likelihood scales with load, and the drop happened during sustained load. Two aggravators observed: (1) the bridge drop logged NOTHING — zero bridge-related lines in 80 MB of capt-hookd.log, so the disconnected state is invisible until probed; (2) new-session hook failures at the same time were a separate mechanism (dead-peer ESRCH verification race + gate misclassification, filed as daemonkit 6215482 + a captain-hook record). Remediation attempt: launchctl kickstart -k of the helper → status moved to "bridge failed: systemCall(connect, errno 61)" immediately post-restart; reconnect polling in progress. Re-verify bridge stability once the wave's load subsides; this record stays open until the EAGAIN handling is fixed.
